events.title: New lights in the dark: v0.18.0
events.summary: Shades now drop six new kinds of light in the demo. Pick one up and it burns for a few seconds, then goes out.New in the demoFireflies (from Night 3): a blinking swarm that drifts around you and stings whatever comes close.Quickening (from Night 4): you run faster and your dash comes back sooner.Aurora (from Night 5): curtains of light hang behind you as you move. Starfall (from Night 7): stars fall onto the shades your light reveals.Slowtide (from Night 8): the night slows down around you. Arc

events.title: Demo update: clearer controls and tips
events.summary: Thanks to everyone playing the demo during Next Fest! A small update based on your feedback: Controller: Focus is now on the right trigger and Nova on the left trigger by default. events.title: The Nightveld demo is out now
events.summary: The free Nightveld demo is live on Steam for Next Fest.Play the first ten Nights: pick your powers at every dawn, face the swarm as each Night grows longer, and see if you can survive the Gloaming waiting at Night 10.The demo runs on Windows, Mac and Linux, with keyboard & mouse or controller.If you play, I'd love to hear how far you got. You can reach me at contact@nightveld.com or on Discord.And if you enjoy it, a wishlist helps more than you'd think.
